attributes.additional_details: Tai Woffinden has given so much over the years, and won the world championship three times. Yet is not mentioned on TV . Let's hope we can get him an honour which he deserves.
attributes.background: Tai Woffinden has been world Speedway champion 3 times, and deserves recognition from the Royal family and The government. For all his hard work and commitment to the sport of speedway. And he has just retired from the injuries he has recently received.
